about_the_game:
Gather your friends for a cozy evening... but beware, there's an impostor among you! In this social deduction game, you'll find yourself in a web of deceit woven around a single secret word. While everyone else knows the word, one person does not: The Impostor, who must bluff to survive.

How to Play

Each round, players give one-word clues related to the secret word. The Impostor's goal is to blend in, using the other players' clues to guess the secret word without getting caught. The goal for everyone else is to identify the Impostor by their strange or out-of-place clue and vote them out. A clever clue can expose the Impostor, but a clue that's too obvious might just hand them the secret on a silver platter! Can you find the balance?

Features

  • Thrilling Social Deduction: Designed for 4-12 players, an online party game built on bluffing, deception, and logical reasoning.

  • Creative Wordplay: This isn't just about lying—it's about the art of finding clever clues without revealing the secret word.

  • Warm and Cozy Atmosphere: Feel like you and your friends are gathered for a fun game night by the fireside.

  • Endless Replayability: With different words and different roles each game, no two rounds are ever the same.

  • Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: The rules are simple, but bluffing like a pro and catching liars takes true skill.

Whether you become the brilliant detective who exposes the lie or the master impostor who deceives everyone... every word, every glance, and every vote matters. Gather your friends and find out who you can truly trust!

short_description: One of you doesn't know the secret word: He's the Impostor! Work with your friends to uncover him by sharing clues, or keep your identity hidden by bluffing. Test your bluffing skills in this fun social deduction game filled with wit, deception, and words. Who can you trust?
